items.name: IIT Patna Unscramble 2024

venue.name: Students' Activity Centre
venue.address: IIT Patna , Bihta Kanpa Rd, Patna, Dayalpur Daulatpur, Bihar 801106

items.information: * Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate. * Attend the new participates tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules. * Bring a Government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition. * Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYyNjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3575910657bc1166efae517ad2762f69428c47d2/Sin%20t%C3%ADtulo%20(27%20x%2014%20cm)%20(3).png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYzMzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--11440f0a7645e9eee6fd94dd70f0e10ebe6fe6c3/Sin%20t%C3%ADtulo%20(27%20x%2014%20cm)%20(5).png) # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español Hay un límite de 100 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2024#45609-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2024#45610-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA. *** # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English Competitor limit: 100. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2024#45609-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2024#45610-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.name: UCSD Weeknights I 2024

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Student Services Center, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093
venue.details: Student Services Center - Multi Purpose Room

items.information: ## This competition is on a weekday! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDWeeknightsI2024#43166-competitor-responsibilities-faq) tab. **Spectators can attend for free** and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
